patch: mg-A-sp4-01.patch (diff -ruN: includes the new file and the deleted transfer_creator.rs; headers are absolute lane paths, rewrite to relative before applying)
desc: mg-A-sp4 win01: +0x26da8 transfer_creator_fees_to_pump (legacy) +0x28dd0 transfer_creator_fees_to_pump_v2, both now byte-identical normalized (diff 0). Changes: (1) FILE MOVE: TransferCreatorFeesToPump/V2 account structs + legacy/v2 handlers moved from src/transfer_creator.rs (deleted) to instructions/coin_creator/transfer_creator_fees_to_pump.rs (orig error-origin path) and `pub mod transfer_creator_fees_to_pump;` added to instructions/coin_creator/mod.rs; (2) lib.rs line 31 (same line, line count unchanged) `mod transfer_creator;` -> `pub use instructions::coin_creator::transfer_creator_fees_to_pump as transfer_creator;` so the handlers are EXTERNAL fns (not inlined into the #[program] fns; __global wrappers still match); (3) `let a=&*ctx.accounts;` (reborrow loads ctx.accounts before the first Rent::get, as orig) in both handlers; (4) min-balance split into its own let: `let min_balance = Rent::get()?.minimum_balance(165); let minimum = min_balance.checked_add(deficit).ok_or(error!(PumpAmmError::Overflow))?;` (this puts the None/overflow arm first like the orig). POSITIONING DEVICES: plain `//` comment lines (two blocks) placed so the Overflow error! lines land on the original lines 88 (legacy) and 239 (v2); file move as above. No #[inline(always)], no behavior change (same checks, CPIs, order, error codes).
